allow: PowerShell(if \($env:VERCEL_TOKEN\) { "VERCEL_TOKEN: presente \(" + $env:VERCEL_TOKEN.Length + " chars\)" } else { "VERCEL_TOKEN: no definido" }; $paths = @\("$env:USERPROFILE\\.vercel\\auth.json", "$env:APPDATA\\com.vercel.cli\\auth.json", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\com.vercel.cli\\auth.json", "$env:USERPROFILE\\AppData\\Roaming\\xdg.config\\com.vercel.cli\\auth.json"\); foreach \($p in $paths\) { if \(Test-Path $p\) { "EXISTE: $p" } }; try { $v = \(Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction Stop\).Source; "vercel CLI: $v" } catch { "vercel CLI: no instalado" })

PowerShell($creds = cmdkey /list | Select-String -Pattern 'vercel' -SimpleMatch; if \($creds\) { $creds } else { "Credential Manager: nada de Vercel" }; if \(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.config"\) { Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.config" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'vercel' } | Select-Object FullName }; if \(Test-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\com.vercel.cli"\) { "EXISTE: $env:LOCALAPPDATA\\com.vercel.cli" }; Get-ChildItem "C:\\xampp\\htdocs" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $vp = Join-Path $_.FullName ".vercel"; if \(Test-Path $vp\) { "Proyecto con .vercel: $\($_.FullName\)" } })
